description: This file defines a Python class 'HeaderFileParser' that parses C++ header files to extract methods, properties, enums, structs, and iterators. It generates request and response JSON examples for methods and manages symbol information, including descriptions and examples. It also links methods to events and logs missing or unassociated components.

classes.name: HeaderFileParser
classes.description: A class for parsing C++ header files to extract structural components, generate JSON examples, and manage symbol metadata.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the parser with header file path, plugin name, and logger, then processes and post-processes the header file.

methods.name: process_header_file
methods.description: Parses the header file, sorts components, and links methods to events.

methods.name: post_process
methods.description: Performs post-processing tasks such as generating examples, descriptions, and logging.

methods.name: parse_header_file
methods.description: Reads the header file line-by-line, parsing enums, structs, methods, and iterators.

methods.name: match_line_with_regex
methods.description: Matches a line against a list of regex patterns to identify component types.

methods.name: process_method
methods.description: Processes a line within a method definition, accumulating lines until the method is complete.

methods.name: process_enum
methods.description: Processes lines within an enum definition, registering the enum when complete.

methods.name: process_struct
methods.description: Processes lines within a struct definition, registering the struct when complete.

methods.name: update_doxy_tags
methods.description: Updates doxygen tags and related metadata based on parsed lines.

methods.name: clean_and_validate_cpp_obj_line
methods.description: Validates and cleans multi-line C++ object lines, checking for comments and delimiters.

methods.name: remove_inline_comments
methods.description: Removes inline comments from a line.

methods.name: register_iterator
methods.description: Registers an iterator type based on regex matches.

methods.name: register_enum
methods.description: Registers an enum and its members.

methods.name: register_struct
methods.description: Registers a struct and its members, including type and description.

methods.name: register_method
methods.description: Registers a method, property, or event based on regex match and scope.

methods.name: build_method_info
methods.description: Builds a method information dictionary, including parameters and results.

methods.name: normalize_key
methods.description: Normalizes keys for symbol registry.

methods.name: process_and_register_params
methods.description: Processes method parameters and registers symbols, returning params and results.

methods.name: get_info_from_param_declaration
methods.description: Extracts parameter info from a declaration string.

methods.name: register_symbol
methods.description: Registers a symbol with type, description, and example.

methods.name: external_struct_tracker
methods.description: Tracks scope of external structs and updates notification and JSON tags.

methods.name: generate_request_response_objects
methods.description: Generates JSON request and response objects for methods, events, and properties.

methods.name: to_camel_case
methods.description: Converts UpperCamelCase to lowerCamelCase.

methods.name: generate_request_object
methods.description: Creates a JSON request object for a method, with example parameters.

methods.name: generate_response_object
methods.description: Creates a JSON response object for a method, with example results.

methods.name: get_symbol_example
methods.description: Retrieves an example value for a symbol, from description or registry.

methods.name: generate_missing_examples_for_symbol_registry
methods.description: Fills in missing examples for symbols in the registry.

methods.name: generate_example_for_individual_symbol
methods.description: Generates an example for a symbol based on description or type.

methods.name: generate_example_from_description
methods.description: Extracts an example value from a description string.

methods.name: generate_example_from_symbol_type
methods.description: Creates an example value based on symbol type, including structs, enums, and primitives.

methods.name: wrap_example_if_iterator
methods.description: Wraps example in list if symbol is an iterator.

methods.name: link_method_to_event
methods.description: Associates methods with their events.

methods.name: log_unassociated_events
methods.description: Logs events not linked to any method.

methods.name: fill_and_log_missing_symbol_descriptions
methods.description: Fills missing descriptions for symbols and logs missing info.

methods.name: log_missing_method_info
methods.description: Logs methods, events, or symbols with missing info.

methods.name: sanitize_resolution_operator_from_type
methods.description: Removes namespace resolution from type names.

methods.name: count_parentheses
methods.description: Counts parentheses in a line.

methods.name: count_braces
methods.description: Counts braces in a line.

methods.name: sort_dict
methods.description: Sorts a dictionary by keys.

methods.name: generate_flattened_descriptions_for_symbol_registry
methods.description: Creates flattened descriptions for all symbols.

methods.name: get_description_from_individual_symbol
methods.description: Retrieves flattened description for a symbol, including nested structs.

methods.name: flatten_description
methods.description: Recursively flattens struct members into description map.

methods.name: clean_description
methods.description: Cleans description text by removing tags and characters.
